review.assessment: The change adds a new `solution.py` that implements `paginate` by unconditionally appending the remainder after the loop, which directly causes both reported misbehaviors. The implementation fails to strip trailing empty pages when items divide evenly and incorrectly returns a single empty page for empty input lists. Consequently, this submission does not satisfy the task requirement to eliminate all empty pages from the result.

findings.defect: Stray empty page appended after full division
Empty input yields a single empty page instead of an empty result
